refused.attempt: supersede where one person attests both halves
refused.reason: CANONICAL_MASTER_REPLACED is under DUAL CONTROL: its attestations name only {'TEST_ONLY_brand_admin'} — the two attestations must come from two DIFFERENT people. Holding both roles does not make one person two reviewers.
- this WIDENS the scope on ['markets'] — widening is a NEW canonical approval and must pass the complete dual-control process. It may not be recorded as a scope reduction.
- unauthorized: role 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' may NOT 'approve_canonical_master'. Permitted roles: ['BRAND_ADMIN']. (Git authorship is provenance, not authorisation.)

refused.attempt: a variant reclassified INTO the canonical master
refused.reason: a variant reclassification may not make something the canonical master — that is an activation, and it takes full dual control
- a resolution must record an explicit reason

a canonical conflict is resolved by a human. Machine code may raise POSSIBLE_CONFLICT and enumerate the permitted resolutions; choosing between two masters is a judgement about the brand, and it is not reachable from here.

disjoint.note: FR vs DE, EU vs US: the taxonomy PROVES they cannot collide, so both masters stay active.

proven_conflict.reason: markets: EU vs FR: EU is an ancestor of FR

scope_local.note: a fight over France does not invalidate the master approved for the United States. Being maximally destructive is not being safe.

uncertain.note: ATLANTIS is not in the taxonomy. 'We cannot tell' is not 'they do not collide', so it is treated as a conflict and queued for review.

supersession.note: the incumbent's retirement and the successor's activation live in ONE file. There is no instant at which two masters hold the EU.
